## Checklist
- [ ] No secrets, private application code or personal information
- [ ] No model output is directly executed as commands
- [ ] Human approval/integrity controls remain intact
- [ ] Code is original or appropriately licensed
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation updated
- [ ] Source/package/CLI versions and current EN/PT-PT document markers agree
- [ ] Implemented versus planned status, roadmap and changelog reflect the final behavior
- [ ] Approval compatibility and execution contract changes are documented where relevant
